description: Google sign-in: identity verification, linking an administrator-created account by email, deactivated and unlinked accounts.

preconditions: Google token verifier rejects the token (absent, malformed, expired, wrong audience, bad signature or unverified email).
cases.return: GoogleSignInResult Failure(InvalidGoogleToken) (MSG03); no account lookup is made.

preconditions: Google token verifier receives an empty token and returns no identity.

cases.log: Google sign-in succeeded for account {UserId}.; audit row SignedIn (details { method: "google" }).
preconditions: Verifier returns identity { subject: g-100, email: organizer@example.com }.
Active account already linked to subject g-100.
cases.return: GoogleSignInResult Success with the user, capabilities of the role, access token, refresh token (stored) and expiry.

cases.log: Google identity linked to account {UserId}.; audit rows UserGoogleLinked (no details) then SignedIn (method "google").
preconditions: Verifier returns identity { subject: g-200, email: staff@example.com }.
Active account staff@example.com created by an administrator, not yet linked to any Google subject.
cases.return: GoogleSignInResult Success; the account is linked to subject g-200 and the token pair is issued.

cases.log: Google sign-in rejected: account {UserId} is deactivated and was never linked.; audit row SignInFailed (details { method: "google", reason: "account_deactivated" }).
preconditions: Verifier returns identity { subject: g-300, email: former@example.com }.
Account former@example.com is deactivated and was never linked to a Google subject.
cases.return: GoogleSignInResult Failure(AccountDeactivated) (MSG02); the subject is not linked and no token is issued.

cases.log: Google sign-in rejected: no internal account is linked to that Google identity.; no audit row.
preconditions: Verifier returns identity { subject: g-400, email: stranger@gmail.com }.
No internal account has that subject or email.
cases.return: GoogleSignInResult Failure(NotLinked) (MSG05); no account is created.

cases.log: Google sign-in rejected: no internal account is linked to that Google identity.; no audit row.
preconditions: Verifier returns identity { subject: g-500, email: organizer@example.com }.
Account organizer@example.com is already linked to a different subject g-100.
cases.return: GoogleSignInResult Failure(NotLinked) (MSG05): the caller is not the owner of that account, and the account is not re-linked.

cases.log: Google sign-in rejected: account {UserId} is deactivated.; audit row SignInFailed (details { method: "google", reason: "account_deactivated" }).
preconditions: Verifier returns identity { subject: g-100, email: organizer@example.com }.
Account linked to subject g-100 is deactivated.

cases.log: Google sign-in succeeded for account {UserId}.; audit row SignedIn (method "google").
preconditions: Verifier returns identity of a linked active account.
The account role holds no capabilities (BR-04).
cases.return: GoogleSignInResult Success with an empty capability list and a token pair.

precondition: Google token verifier returns an identity or null; account rows seeded.
